recovery.phase: v2.0 Phase R — official historical recovery (2026-11-10)
recovery.approval: Owner instruction 2026-11-10: comprehensive official historical data recovery and comparability; descriptive only, no model input changes.
recovery.floor_rule: floor = max(first official value, territorial floor, year of the last 'b' flag, year after the last 'd' flag) over the whole official series; only years before the earliest admitted year are added
recovery.overlap_rule: splice check: the first five admitted years (Phase G history and observations.json) must agree with the full extract within overlap_tolerance; the excess over all admitted years is reported as all_admitted_overlap_max_excess (later years can carry newer revisions); with no common year the series is accepted only because the current records use the same table and selection

DE.note: German unification (3 October 1990): the extract does not establish that earlier values cover the unified territory, so recovery starts in 1991.

RS.note: Serbian national totals exclude AP Kosovo and Metohija from 1998 (unflagged coverage change recorded in the Atlas SORS indicator mapping); recovery starts in 1999.

CZ.note: Before 1993 (Czechoslovakia), Eurostat values refer to the present-day territory of Czechia.

SK.note: Before 1993 (Czechoslovakia), Eurostat values refer to the present-day territory of Slovakia.

SI.note: Before 1991 (SFR Yugoslavia), Eurostat values refer to the present-day territory of Slovenia.

HR.note: Before 1991 (SFR Yugoslavia), Eurostat values refer to the present-day territory of Croatia.
